# smol-toml 1.9.1

Unmodified `dist/index.cjs` and `LICENSE` from the npm `smol-toml@1.9.1`
tarball (SHA-1 `1262834a084c3ce2985900450956a580f95cf243`).
Upstream: https://github.com/squirrelchat/smol-toml

Vendored so Netlify's ignore check can parse TOML before npm installation.
Update both files together and run the ignore-filter tests. No install scripts
or runtime npm dependencies are needed.
